schema.description: Partial update. All fields optional. If ONLY tags and/or the three review-flag fields (isUncategorisedIgnored / isHighPnLReviewed / isMissingPriceIgnored) are sent — no timestamp/label/description/notes — the update skips isEdited and the balance-recompute trigger. Tags are a free-form organizational label and the review flags are dismiss/un-dismiss toggles for the /reconciliation review page; neither affects balances or cost basis. Tags still survive a wallet resync.

isUncategorisedIgnored.description: Dismiss/un-dismiss from the reconciliation uncategorized count (/reconciliation/summary).

isHighPnLReviewed.description: Dismiss/un-dismiss from the reconciliation high-pnl count (/reconciliation/summary).
